title: What a US-China AI Safety Channel Needs
gist: Lizzi C. Lee and Simon Hedlin note the Trump-Xi summit's most concrete outcome was an apparent US-China AI incident-reporting channel, but argue it will be hollow because frontier AI companies in both countries don't provide the needed information. In the US, no federal rule requires incident reporting and federal bills have stalled, leaving industry self-regulating.
